artifacts.summary: Machine-checked refutation of the stated L-plus compression theorem: no branching witness family certifies any instance of (g S e) -> stab (g S e), root-caused to (C1')'s snce clause, with the substrate redesign specification, the two absent prerequisites, and the bound shape for whenever the conditions are fixed.

Four green declarations: snce_state_determined (root cause), no_certificate and no_certificate_premise_form (empty certificate class, both target placements), not_plusValidZTime_instance (the schema is a genuine ZTime non-validity).

user_decision.question: Research machine-refuted this task's stated deliverable: no branching L-plus witness family can certify any instance of (g S e) -> stab (g S e), while one such instance (Pp -> stab Pp) is a genuine ZTime non-validity, so the compression theorem is false against the landed six conditions rather than merely unproved. How should the task be re-scoped?
options: Land the refutation and re-scope - promote the probe to a library module beside PlusWitnessFamily, correct the two READMEs, and spawn the substrate redesign and the L-plus carrier normalization as separate dependent tasks; attempt no compression proof now

Attempt the substrate redesign inside this task - add the explicit periodic transition relation to SharingSkeleton and re-prove the ~3500 affected lines (Skeleton, Predicates, Decide, Fulfil, Agreement, Specialize on both the Formula and PlusFormula sides) before compressing
Restrict the claim - prove compression and decidability only for the snce-free fragment of L-plus, where the defect provably cannot bite, and record the general case as open
user_decision.recommended: Land the refutation and re-scope - promote the probe to a library module beside PlusWitnessFamily, correct the two READMEs, and spawn the substrate redesign and the L-plus carrier normalization as separate dependent tasks; attempt no compression proof now
